note: Provisional planted cases for ADR 0030 realization calibration. These fixtures measure whether plan-blind extraction plus a separate aligner can distinguish a planted required-event omission from literal and oblique realizations. They are diagnostic controls, not literary gold labels or authority to enable prose_audit as a production gate.

cases.prose: Mara counted the invoices twice, stacked them under the ledger, and switched off the desk lamp.
Mara pushed the manifest back across the desk. "No. Send the shipment back."
Mara folded the unsigned manifest into quarters and slid it beneath the driver's empty coffee cup. She held his gaze until he took both away.

required_events.description: Mara refuses the offered shipment without stating the refusal directly.
